card.name: Lyme disease text predicting tick
card.fires_on: Spaces, numbers, and small linking words in passages about Lyme disease, where the next word is likely to be tick or ticks. It fires on the position just before the expected word, not on a tick word itself.

modes.label: Space before stage or dose
modes.description: A space before a stage number or dose in Lyme disease lists.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward tick and ticks, and toward Borrelia, the tick-borne germ.
